source.title: 诊断学（第10版）
source.section: 第五篇 辅助检查 第一章 心电图 第六节

scope: Grouped conduction with a fixed PR for conducted beats, not a Wenckebach cycle or a complete Mobitz II pathological preset.

notes: Each N atrial cycles conduct the first K consecutively and block the remaining N-K. The demo adds 3:2 and 4:3 schedules with user-specified PR; ventricular mechanical events retain the existing electromechanical offset.

compatibility: K=1 preserves the original N:1 samples and ventricular cycleIndex. K>1 retains atrial slot indices and uses the shortest RR for QT bounds. It cannot be combined with independent ventricular clocks or beatwise mechanical ratios/switching schedules.
limitations: Progressive beatwise PR prolongation and Wenckebach cycles are not implemented.
Third-degree AV block and escape origins/morphologies are not implemented.
Pressure retains the original RC runoff without beatwise filling or ejection-volume feedback.
Grouped conduction ratios are not automatically diagnosed as Mobitz I or II.
